steps.label: One contiguous block per request

eyebrow: Borrowed directly from OS virtual memory

steps.label: Logical blocks (per request)
steps.sub: block 0, block 1, block 2 … fixed-size, 16 tokens each

steps.label: Block table
steps.sub: maps each logical block to a physical block

eyebrow: Indirection unlocks more than space savings

steps.label: Near-zero fragmentation
steps.sub: waste capped at a fraction of one block

steps.label: Shared physical blocks
steps.sub: identical prefixes point to the same memory

code:
# Request A's logical blocks -> physical block IDs
block_table["req_A"] = [block_42, block_7, block_91]

# Request B shares the same system prompt (blocks 0-1)
block_table["req_B"] = [block_42, block_7, block_15]
#                        ^shared^  ^shared^  ^own copy, diverged here
caption: Blocks 42 and 7 are physically shared until request B's content diverges from A's — then it copy-on-writes.
